text: そんなに　むきに　なるのは　ナンセンスだな

structure.jp: そんなに　むきに　なるのは

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. むきに　なるの = 'getting worked up'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に plus なる means 'to become' that state. むきに　なる = 'to get worked up'.
